name: 186-ten-minute-audit-soak
command:
set -euo pipefail
sudo kubectl create serviceaccount audit-capacity-probe
sudo kubectl create rolebinding audit-capacity-probe --clusterrole=view --user=audit-capacity-probe
for i in $(seq 1 11); do
 date -u +%FT%TZ
 sudo kubectl create token audit-capacity-probe --duration=10m >/dev/null
 sudo kubectl annotate rolebinding audit-capacity-probe qa-round="$i" --overwrite >/dev/null
 sudo kubectl -n kof get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kof-collectors-daemon-collector -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;x=json.load(sys.stdin)["items"];assert len(x)==1; p=x[0];s=p["status"]["containerStatuses"];print(p["metadata"]["name"],[(c["ready"],c["restartCount"]) for c in s]);assert all(c["ready"] and c["restartCount"]==0 for c in s)'
 sudo kubectl get --raw /api/v1/nodes/ip-10-0-9-27/proxy/stats/summary | python3 -c 'import json,sys;x=json.load(sys.stdin);print([(p["podRef"]["name"],p.get("memory",{}).get("workingSetBytes")) for p in x["pods"] if "daemon-collector" in p["podRef"]["name"]])'
 if [ "$i" -lt 11 ]; then sleep 60; fi
done
